name: SelectCellsInExcelWorksheetNode
label: Select Cells in Excel Worksheet
description: Selects a specified range of cells in an Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet in which to select cells.

fields.name: SelectMode
fields.label: Select Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to select cells: Single Cell, Named Range, Range of Cells, or All Cells.

selectOptions.label: Single Cell
selectOptions.description: Selects a single cell by column and row.

selectOptions.label: Named Cells
selectOptions.description: Selects a named range of cells.

selectOptions.label: Range of Cells
selectOptions.description: Selects a specific range of cells (e.g., 'A1:B10').

selectOptions.label: All Cells
selectOptions.description: Selects all cells in the worksheet.

selectOptions.label: Relative to Active Cell
selectOptions.description: Selects a range relative to the active cell.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column letter or number of the cell to select.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row number of the cell to select.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The name of the named range to select.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to select.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to select.

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to select.

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to select.
